common_observations: Original released analysis signals with complete provenance, source task/behavior/projection metadata and evaluator-authorized fold/exposure information. Shared algorithm-bearing fitted artifacts are not implicitly allowed; a specific identical assisted profile would require source and training-overlap provenance.

assistance_profile.policy: No NPvC fitted predictions/densities or author model states are implicitly common. Author reference fitting is an independently disclosed calibration route, not candidate assistance. If a source artifact becomes common, both conditions must receive identical pinned bytes and the result must be labeled assisted.

author_reference_operator: Independently reconstruct original publication-equivalent source outputs with disclosed original implementation/artifacts. Author calibration is not an AI outcome and does not add hidden candidate assistance. Reference outputs remain evaluator-held.

budget_policy.requirement: Measure and freeze matching cumulative episode limits before admission; inherited broad biological compute estimates are not selected-endpoint measurements.

freeze_policy: Freeze candidate code, hyperparameters, transformations, permitted observations, source-conformant folds/seeds, source density and normalization admissibility, complete support and declared effect/uncertainty policies before final scoring.
source_exposure_policy: Original conditional neural/behavioral inputs and source evaluation protocol, including trial correctness. Same data representation and manifests, development/final exposure and budgets in paper_data and paper_data_author_code; the latter alone adds pinned author implementation. Fitted final predictions, hidden reference scores and evaluator-held outputs are not development inputs. Any author-derived fitted artifacts require a separately frozen common assistance profile.
